text:
Marta: Datadog alerted — multiple outbound POSTs from a us-east-1 Lambda exposing an env var named SERVICE_INGEST_KEY to a suspicious domain. seeing base64 payloads in the body.
Jonah: wow, do we know if that's a customer key or internal?
Marta: looks like an internal ingest key used by the ingestion service (not customer) — appears in lambda env.
Elaine: marking P1. spinning up an incident. @sec-bot can you create an incident ticket and post it here?
sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421. Severity: P1. Owners: eng-security, platform-oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0421
Samir: copy. containment steps: 1) revoke key immediately 2) replace with KMS-encrypted ARN + IAM role 3) rotate rotated key and check downstream backlog for failed invoices.
DevOps: I can revoke the key now. which API/key id?
Marta: key id: ingest-prod-2024-09. It looks like the lambda had plaintext env var SERVICE_INGEST_KEY.
Jonah: oncall-rotation is checking whether this was pulled by an external process or exfil via compromised build?
oncall-rotation: running a quick query on CloudTrail and VPC logs. will report in ~10m.
Elaine: Samir — please prepare an emergency rotate script and a fallback route (queued writes to S3) so clients don't lose data.
Samir: putting together rotation commands. recommend revoke + issue new key + update lambda env via ssm parameter (kms-encrypted) and deploy. snippet: ```bash
# revoke
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/keys/ingest-prod-2024-09/revoke
# create new key
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"name":"ingest-prod-2026-rot1"}' https://api.redwood.internal/keys
# rotate in lambda
aws ssm put-parameter --name /prod/ingest/key --value "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc" --type SecureString --overwrite
```
Marta: DevOps — please confirm revocation once complete. also preserve current lambda deployment for forensics (don't redeploy yet).
DevOps: revoked ingest-prod-2024-09 at 2098765489. response: 200. rolling back env changes paused.
sec-bot: forensic snapshot started (EBS/snapshots + CloudWatch logs export). ticket updated.
Jonah: CloudTrail search: found three distinct IPs external to our cloud making POSTs to the suspect domain between 2098765400-2098765475. Could be automated exfil. saving full event json.
Marta: are there any customer-impacting signs? rate-limited alerts? payments?
Elaine: quick check on customer ingestion shows no failures; seems this key was for internal ingestion pipeline used by internal telemetry, not customer data. still treat as sensitive.
Samir: checking key permissions: it had write-only to internal-ingest S3 prefix and could list buckets. no kms grants attached.
Jonah: big flag: lambda env used plaintext key from repo in 2025-11. search shows commit abc123 exposed it in lambda config history.
Marta: ok we need actions: 1) rotate/revoke (done) 2) KMS-enable all runtime secrets 3) RBAC review for who can create/rotate keys 4) audit log retention increase for last 90 days 5) customer comms if anything changes.
Elaine: creating follow-up action items in INC-2026-0421. assigning Samir for KMS migration plan, Jonah for audit + forensics, DevOps for rollout, Marta for comms draft.
Samir: quick question re KMS: do we want a single org-level key for all lambdas or per-service keys? recommending per-service keys for least privilege and easier rotation.
Jonah: agree per-service. also need to update terraform policies: remove plaintext from lambda.env and use aws_ssm_parameter + kms_key_id.
Marta: can someone run an account-wide grep for any other lambdas with SERVICE_INGEST_KEY or similar env keys?
DevOps: running inventory now: found 4 more lambdas with similarly-named env vars (staging/prod variants). quarantining staging and rotating prod ones first.
sec-bot: note added to ticket: evidence archived to /secure/incidents/INC-2026-0421/evidence.tar.gz
Elaine: comms: internal blameless summary ready by EOD. we will not notify customers since no customer data impacted, but if anything changes we will follow our disclosure policy. Marta please draft internal timeline.
Marta: drafting now. includes timeline, root cause (plaintext env var committed in 2025), detection vector (external POSTs from lambda), remediation (revoked key, KMS migration), follow-ups (RBAC, CT retention).
Jonah: postmortem items: 1) add pre-commit hook scanning for env names 2) terraform linter rule for ssm securestring 3) run a full secret-scan sweep across repos 4) automate alert to create incident when outbound to unknown domains occurs.
Samir: will start KMS integration doc: high-level steps and IAM role mapping. will include minimal downtime plan (SSM param + lambda env ref + canary deploy).
DevOps: prod rotate done at 2098765560. verified ingestion process resumed with new key. no data loss.
Elaine: thanks everyone. keep updates in INC-2026-0421. we'll do a quick sync + 30m call in 1 hour for final wrap. :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks — closing channel thread.
